annotations.title: The team's domains: registration expiry, registrar, nameservers, status

description: Wraps GET /api/domains. The team's domains: registration expiry, registrar, nameservers, status. Call this to check renewals: which domains expire soon, who the registrar is, and whether nameservers or registry locks changed.
name: domains

expiresAt.description: when its registration ends (ISO 8601, UTC); null when there's none

lastCheckedAt.description: when RDAP was last read (ISO 8601, UTC); null when there's none

confirmedAt.description: when (ISO 8601, UTC); null when there's none

gaps.description: what the confirmation left unticked (a personal inbox, one login)

seenAt.description: when the registrar's renewal was last seen (the expiry moved forward before the old one); the registry's own renewal after expiry never counts (ISO 8601, UTC); null when there's none

state.description: what the team knows: a person's confirmation (a year, asked again after a renewal), or Cloudflare Registrar's own setting

words.description: the same in a sentence, as alerts say it

sites.description: the slugs of the team's sites on it

next_steps.description: calls that usually come next, each naming its tool

tool.description: the tool that makes this call
